Academic resources and books

Toolkit & Books

Teacher resources, the Freirean toolkit, plant science education, puzzle books, and community resilience.

The Freirean Teacher Toolkit is the primary education-resource product on this site.
Toolkit question

How do you support students experiencing homelessness, when no one trained you for it?

This comprehensive, classroom-ready guide is here to fill that gap. Complete French-language edition included: Trousse de prévention transformative de l’itinérance jeunesse pour les enseignants Freiriens.
